name: smwgraphics-final-fantasy-v-the-ancient-library-battle-background
title: Final Fantasy V - The Ancient Library (Battle Background)
description:
A very simple, but, beautiful background used in the battles of the Ancient Library, from the classic Final Fantasy V. It can fit maybe levels with some magical stuff, maybe? It's a very nice background and it doesn't scroll at all, so use it with BG Scroll : None, None. This rip was part of my C3 Graphic Ripping Showcase .

Massive update: Reripped from scratch. Now it's accurate to the original version, while using better palette rows.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
